articles.title: Scripps Sports and ION score U.S. media rights for the 2027 FIVB Women’s Volleyball World Cup

articles.summary: CINCINNATI – The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) has reached a new retransmission consent agreement with DIRECTV, completing its three largest cable and satellite distribution renewals of 2026.
articles.title: Scripps reaches third major retransmission deal of 2026 with DIRECTV renewal

articles.summary: Scripps Networks and Nomadic Pictures have announced production on “The Horseman,” a feature-length Western slated for global release in early 2027.
articles.title: Scripps Networks partners with Nomadic Pictures on new original movie, ‘The Horseman’

articles.summary: CINCINNATI – The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) has promoted veteran television leader Dean Littleton to president of media, combining leadership of the company’s enterprise television and broadcast operations under Littleton in a newly created role for the company.
articles.title: Scripps unites television operations under Dean Littleton’s leadership

articles.summary: CINCINNATI – The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) will report second-quarter 2026 operating results after the markets close on Thursday, Aug. 6. The call with the company’s senior management team will take place at 9:30 a.m. Eastern time on Friday, Aug. 7.
articles.title: Scripps to release second-quarter 2026 operating results on Aug. 6
